list_child.name: listScrimBlocks
list_child.desc: This tool returns every scrim block currently on the org's practice calendar, across every game title and opponent. Use it whenever a full view of scheduled and past scrims is needed for planning.

get_child.name: getScrimBlock
get_child.desc: This tool retrieves a single scrim block record by its id, including the opposing org, game title, and current state. Use it when only one specific scrim needs to be reviewed.

list_parent.name: listOrgs
list_parent.desc: This tool lists every partner org the team has scrimmed against or arranged scrims with, regardless of current activity. Use it to see the full roster of scrim partners.

get_parent.name: getOrg
get_parent.desc: This tool fetches a single partner org record by id, returning their contact details and scrim history. Use it when details on one specific org are required.

delete_child.name: purgeScrimBlock
delete_child.desc: This tool permanently deletes a scrim block from the org's calendar, and the action cannot be undone once submitted. Use it only when a scrim was booked in error or has been fully replaced.

set_enum.name: setScrimState
set_enum.desc: This tool changes a scrim block's state between scheduled, played, and scrapped, tracking whether the practice actually happened. Use it once a scrim's outcome is known and needs to be logged.

set_bool.name: flagHighStakes
set_bool.desc: This tool marks a scrim block as high-stakes, flagging it as important practice ahead of a tournament. Use it when a scrim carries extra weight for roster evaluation or prep.

set_ref.name: reassignOrg
set_ref.desc: This tool moves a scrim block from its currently listed opponent org to a different one entirely. Use it when a scrim was logged against the wrong org and needs correcting.

send.name: emailOrg
send.desc: This tool sends an email to a partner org, either about a specific scrim block or as a direct note. Use it to confirm scrim times or follow up after a session.
